summary_en: Kamgras 1 K.K. (bidder) adjusts tender price for Kakaku.com (TSE Prime, ticker 2371) from ¥3,570 to ¥3,571 per share. Tender offer period extended to 10 Sep 2026 (85 business days total). Initial offer launched 13 May 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change to Terms of Tender Offer for Shares of Kakaku.com, Inc. (Ticker 2371) by Kamgras 1 K.K.
translation_en_brief: On 27 August 2026, Kamgras 1 K.K. (bidder) announced a modification to its outstanding tender offer for all ordinary shares and share warrants of Kakaku.com, Inc. (TSE Prime, ticker 2371). The tender price per share has been raised from ¥3,570 to ¥3,571. Concurrent with this price adjustment and in accordance with applicable law, the tender offer period has been extended from 27 August 2026 by 10 business days, bringing the total offer period to 85 business days, with a new deadline of 10 September 2026. The original tender offer was commenced on 13 May 2026. The bidder indicated that the price adjustment was determined after considering market conditions, shareholder subscription response to date, forward subscription outlook, and a negotiation communication dated 29 July 2026, with the view that the revised ¥3,571 price represents a realistic upper bound above the ¥3,520 threshold mentioned in a prior proposal.
